DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩コースの距離をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the distance of the walking course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 標識に二百メートルとあります。ここから先が二百メートルなのか、ここまで歩いた距離なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 距離標識が残り距離か累積距離か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sign says two hundred metres. I do not know whether that means two hundred metres ahead or the distance walked to here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the distance sign shows remaining or accumulated distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口の起点から、ここまでが二百メートルです。次の標識は四百メートルになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is two hundred metres from the starting point at the entrance to here. The next sign says four hundred metres.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一周の残りが二百という意味ではないのですね。一周は何メートルですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周の長さを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it does not mean two hundred metres left in the circuit. How long is the full circuit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the length of one circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一周は八百メートルです。入口に戻るなら、先へ回るとあと六百メートルになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: One circuit is eight hundred metres. To return to the entrance by continuing around, it is another six hundred metres.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は全部で四百メートルくらいにしたいので、ここから来た道を戻るのがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望総距離から同じ道で折り返すと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to walk about four hundred metres in total today, so going back the way I came seems best.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest turning back along the same path based on your desired total distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。入口からここまでと、ここから入口までで、四百メートルになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. From the entrance to here and back to the entrance makes four hundred metres.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ちょうどよいです。次に一周したい時は、この標識の数字が増える方向へ進めばよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回一周する時の標識の進む方向を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is just right. When I want a full circuit next time, I should follow the direction where these sign numbers increase, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the direction of the signs for walking a full circuit next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方向です。最後の標識は七百メートルで、そこから入口まで百メートルです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is the direction. The final sign is seven hundred metres, then one hundred metres to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 数字は起点からの距離と分かりました。今日は二百の所で折り返して、入口で休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 標識の意味を理解し今日の折返し地点と休憩先を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the numbers are distances from the starting point. Today I will turn back at two hundred and rest at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the signs and decide today's turning point and rest location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご自分のペースで。お散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Go at your own pace. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の放送についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the announcement just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。補聴器を使っていますが、音が重なって聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 補聴器使用と放送が聞き取れない事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I use a hearing aid, but the overlapping sounds made it impossible to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your hearing aid use and why you could not understand the announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の列車が、このホームを通過するという案内でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It said the next train will pass through this platform without stopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗る列車ではないのですね。通過のあとに来る列車は、どこで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通過列車と停車列車を区別して表示場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not the train I should board. Where can I check the train that comes after it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the passing and stopping trains and ask where the display is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 頭上の表示に、次の停車列車の時刻が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The overhead display shows the time of the next stopping train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文字が小さいので、手元の紙に時刻を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻を大きな文字で書いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The letters are small. Could you write the time on the paper I have here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the time written in large letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十五時二十二分です。こちらに大きく書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is fifteen twenty-two. I will write it large here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。変更があった場合、文字の案内も出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更時の文字案内の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. If there is a change, will there also be a written announcement?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether changes are also shown in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この表示が更新されます。見づらいときは、ホーム中央の係員にもお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This display will be updated. If it is hard to see, ask the staff member in the middle of the platform too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙の時刻を見ながら待ちます。変更があれば、中央の係員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を使って待ち変更時の相談先を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait while checking the time on the paper. If anything changes, I will ask the staff in the middle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait using the paper and whom to ask about changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。どうぞお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市民会議の案内をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the citizens' meeting information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の照明について意見があります。会議で話せるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園照明の意見を会議で述べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an opinion about park lighting. Can I speak at the meeting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wish to express an opinion about park lighting at the meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は、傍聴と意見提出を別に受け付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This time, observing and submitting opinions are handled separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 傍聴の席で直接話すのではなく、意見を出す手続きがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傍聴と意見提出の違いを理解して言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So rather than speaking directly from the observers' seats, there is a procedure for submitting an opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Restate your understanding of observing versus submitting opinions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。意見用紙を事前に出す方法と、終了後の受付があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can submit a form beforehand or use the reception after the meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昼は働いているので、用紙で出したいです。場所の地図を添えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用紙提出を選び地図の添付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I work in the daytime, so I would like to submit a form. May I attach a map of the location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a written submission and ask about attaching a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。暗く感じる区間が分かる地図を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Attach a map showing the sections you find dark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 回答は個別に届きますか。それとも、まとめて公表されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 意見への回答方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Will replies be sent individually, or published together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how opinions will be answered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が意見を整理し、回答の方法も案内します。用紙の連絡先欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will organise the opinions and explain how replies are handled. Please see the contact details section on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を書きます。照明を増やしてほしい区間を地図で示して、担当へ提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先と地図を付け担当へ提出すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my contact details. I will show the sections where I want more lighting on the map and submit it to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will submit your contact details and map to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの担当窓口へどうぞ。ご意見ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this designated counter. Thank you for your opinion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 一日分の尿を集める検査の説明書ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are the instructions for collecting a full day's urine, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事中に持ち歩くのが難しいので、家にいる日で予定を組みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事中の持運びを避け自宅にいる日の蓄尿検査を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is difficult to carry it at work, so I would like to schedule it for a day I am at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a home-day urine collection test to avoid carrying it during work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 採取日の希望は、検査の担当に確認できます。いつなら家にいられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check your preferred collection date with the test staff. When can you stay home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜は一日家にいます。月曜の朝も、出勤前なら病院へ持ってこられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日曜在宅と月曜出勤前の持参可能時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am home all day Sunday. On Monday morning, I can bring it to the hospital before work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain Sunday at home and Monday morning delivery before work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日曜から月曜朝の予定として担当へ伝えます。容器は受け取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff the proposed Sunday-to-Monday-morning schedule. Have you received the container?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この容器です。説明書に開始時刻を書く欄がありますが、終わりの時刻も控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器を示し開始だけでなく終了時刻も記録したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is it. The instructions have a space for the start time, but I want to note the end time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the container and ask to record the end as well as start time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始と終了は、担当から指定された時刻を書いてください。欄の下にもメモできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write the start and end times specified by the staff. You can also make notes below the space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方をメモできるのですね。家で保管する場所も、説明書で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二時刻の記録を理解し保管説明の欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I can note both. I also want to check the instructions for where to store it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand recording both times and ask where the storage instructions are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この欄が保管の説明です。分からない点を、検査の担当と一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the storage section. Let us check any unclear points with the test staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日曜の採取と月曜朝の持参が可能か確認します。指定された二つの時刻と保管方法を、担当の説明を聞いて書き込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採取持参日程と指定二時刻と保管方法を担当と確認して記入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check whether Sunday collection and Monday-morning delivery are possible. After hearing the staff's explanation, I will write the two specified times and storage method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm the schedule, two specified times and storage method with staff and write them down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、容器と説明書を持って担当席へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the container and instructions to the staff's desk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活の中で気になることのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your enquiry about something troubling you in daily life?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎晩、家の前でバイクの空ぶかしがあります。眠れなくて困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜間の空ぶかしと睡眠への影響を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Every night motorcycles rev their engines in front of my house. I cannot sleep and it is causing trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe nighttime engine revving and its effect on sleep. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、バイクはそこにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今はいません。夜十一時ごろから、十分ほど続きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在は不在で発生時刻と継続時間を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not now. It starts around eleven at night and lasts about ten minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they are not there now and give the start time and duration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を地図で教えてください。道路上でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the location on the map. Is it on the road?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この路地の入口です。道路に二台くらい停まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で道路上の場所と台数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the entrance to this alley. About two motorcycles stop on the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the road location and number of vehicles on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時や聞こえ方を記録しているものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have records of dates, times and how the sound was heard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三日分をメモしました。窓を閉めても聞こえたことも書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三日分の記録と屋内への音の影響を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote notes for three days. I also wrote that I heard it even with the windows closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain three days of records and the sound's impact indoors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモを拝見して、担当へ伝えます。また起きたときの連絡先もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will look at the notes and tell the person in charge. I will also give you a contact number for if it happens again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このメモを出します。次に連絡するときは、始まった時刻と今の状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録提出と再発時に伝える内容を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit these notes. Next time I contact you, I will give the start time and current situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to submit records and what to report if it happens again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Thank you for consulting us. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記念切手をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see commemorative stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。花の絵の切手を集めています。今あるシートを見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花の記念切手の在庫シートを見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I collect stamps with flower pictures. Could you show me the sheets currently in stock?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to see available sheets of flower commemorative stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの二種類です。片方は春の花、もう片方は季節を通した花です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: These two types. One has spring flowers, and the other flowers through the seasons.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一年の花が載った方にします。周りの絵も残したいので、切り離さずに買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一年の花のシートを選び切り離さない購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will choose the flowers of the year. I want to keep the surrounding artwork too. Can I buy it without separating the stamps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the year-round flower sheet and ask to buy it unseparated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: シートのままお渡しできます。折らない方がよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give you the complete sheet. Would you prefer it unfolded?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。台紙に挟んで持ち帰りたいです。この書類入れに入る大きさでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折らず台紙に挟む希望と書類入れへの適合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I want to take it home between backing sheets. Will it fit this document holder?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request no folds, protective backing, and ask whether it fits your document holder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この向きで、余白まで収まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this direction, even the margins fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入りました。今日は使わずに保存するので、そのまま書類入れに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 収納を試し当日は使用せず保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It fits. I will preserve it rather than use it today, so put it straight in the document holder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try fitting it and say you will preserve it without using it today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの価格になります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この価格でお願いします。支払って、周りの絵が付いた一枚のシートを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 価格を了承し余白付きシートを支払い受領する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: That price is fine. I will pay and receive one complete sheet with the surrounding artwork.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the price, pay and receive the sheet including its margins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 折らずにお入れしました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have put it in without folding. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お取引についてお伺いしてよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about your transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に、機械の音が大きくて聞こえにくいです。静かな席で話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機械音で聞き取りづらく静かな相談席を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, the machine is loud and makes it hard to hear. Can we talk at a quiet seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a quiet consultation seat because machine noise makes hearing difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥の相談席へ移れます。お荷物はこちらの鞄だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can move to the consultation seats at the back. Is this bag your only luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この鞄を持って移ります。番号札も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鞄一つと答え番号札を持つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will take this bag with me. Do I need the queue number ticket too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have one bag and ask whether to take the number ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号札もお持ちください。ご相談の順番はこちらで引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Take the ticket too. We will transfer your place in the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ちました。今日の相談は、毎月の積立額を変えることです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号札を持ち積立額変更の用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have it. Today's enquiry is about changing my monthly savings contribution.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Take the ticket and explain your savings contribution change enquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者へ用件を伝えます。今の額と希望の額は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person in charge. Do you know the present and desired amounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は一万円で、五千円にしたいです。手続きの説明は紙でも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在と希望の積立額を示し紙の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is ten thousand yen now, and I want five thousand. I would like the procedure's explanation on paper too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the current and desired contribution and request a paper explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙の案内を用意します。変更できる時期と条件は担当者が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will prepare written information. The person in charge will explain timing and conditions for changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 静かな席で、紙を見ながら担当の説明を聞きます。次の引落しから変えられるか質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 静かな席で紙を使い変更適用時期を担当に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen at a quiet seat while looking at the paper. I will ask whether it can change from the next deduction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use a quiet seat and paper to ask staff when the change applies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、奥の席へご案内します。よろしくお願いいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the seat at the back. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この魚をお取りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I get this fish for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。焼く用と汁物用に使いたいので、三枚におろしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 調理用途を説明し三枚おろしを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want it for grilling and soup. Could you cut it into two fillets and the backbone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the cooking uses and request Japanese three-piece filleting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: できます。皮は付けたままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can. Leave the skin on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 皮は残してください。骨の部分も、汁物に使うので持って帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 皮を残し骨も持ち帰る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please keep the skin. I would like the bones too, for soup.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request skin left on and bones to take home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 骨は別の袋に入れます。切り身はさらに小さく切りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will put the bones in a separate bag. Shall we cut the fillets smaller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で食べるので、左右の身をそれぞれ半分にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の四切れに切るよう指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is for two people, so cut each side's fillet in half.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify four pieces for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四切れですね。処理に十分ほどかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Four pieces. Preparation takes about ten minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その間に野菜を買います。受け取りは、このカウンターですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待ち時間の買い物と受取場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy vegetables meanwhile. Do I collect it at this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm shopping during the wait and where to collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この番号札をお持ちください。出来上がったらお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Take this number ticket. We will give it to you when it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札を受け取りました。買い物のあと、四切れの身と骨を取りに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号札を受け取り加工内容を踏まえ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the ticket. After shopping I will come back for the four pieces and bones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the ticket and say you will return for the requested preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。引き続きお買い物をどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Please continue shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時計塔の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the clock tower?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と三時に待ち合わせていますが、塔の時計が止まっているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合せ時刻と停止した時計への疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am meeting a friend at three, but the tower clock seems stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the meeting time and ask about the stopped clock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 修理中です。今は二時五十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is under repair. It is two fifty now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと十分ですね。塔の下は工事の囲いがあるので、どこで待てばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残り時間を把握し囲いを避けた待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten minutes left. There is construction fencing below the tower; where should I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Work out the remaining time and ask for a waiting place away from fencing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 向かいの赤いベンチなら、塔も入口も見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: From the red bench opposite, you can see both the tower and entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そのベンチに移ります。友人には、入口から見てどちら側と伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ伝えるベンチの方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go to that bench. Which side should I tell my friend it is on when looking from the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to describe the bench's direction to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時計塔の左手です。赤いベンチは一つだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Left of the clock tower. There is only one red bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左手の赤いベンチですね。待っている間、工事の車が通ることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 位置を復唱し作業車の通路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The red bench on the left. Will construction vehicles pass while I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the location and check the construction vehicle route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベンチの裏の作業通路を使います。囲いの中へは入らずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: They use the work passage behind the bench. Wait without entering the fenced area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に場所の変更を送りました。ベンチの前側で、入口を見ながら待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更連絡を済ませ待ち方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have sent my friend the changed location. I will wait at the front of the bench, looking towards the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Notify the changed location and decide how to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、よいお時間をお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅前のバスへお乗り換えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing to a bus outside the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。雨が強いので、屋根のある道で乗場へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強雨のため屋根のあるバス乗場への道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The rain is heavy, so I would like a covered route to the stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a covered route to the bus stop because of heavy rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 西口から連絡通路を通れます。どちら方面のバスですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can take the connecting passage from the west exit. Which direction is your bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市民会館方面です。バスの番号は二十六と聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市民会館方面と二十六番を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Towards the civic hall. I was told the bus number is twenty-six.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State civic hall direction and bus twenty-six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その便は三番乗場です。連絡通路を出て左へ曲がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That service uses stop three. Turn left out of the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左の三番ですね。乗場にも屋根がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗場位置を確認し待機場所の屋根を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Stop three on the left. Is there a roof at the stop too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the stop location and ask about cover where you wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ場所にはあります。バスへ乗る最後の数歩は、屋根がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The waiting area is covered. The last few steps onto the bus are not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら傘を閉じずに乗場まで持っていきます。駅の通路では畳んだ方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗場まで傘を持つと決め通路での扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will take my umbrella to the stop without folding it. Should I fold it in the station passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to take your umbrella to the stop and ask how to handle it in the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路は屋根がありますので、畳んでお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The passage is covered, so please fold it there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで傘を畳み、西口の通路を出たら開きます。左の三番で二十六番のバスを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傘を畳む場所と開く場所と乗場を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fold it here and open it after leaving the west-exit passage. I will wait for bus twenty-six at stop three on the left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide where to fold and reopen the umbrella and which stop to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お足元にお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch your step. Have a safe journey.
